name: Sarah M.
text: This is so helpful! I've been driving myself crazy trying to figure out if my baby's cry means hunger or just tiredness. The frequency breakdown actually makes sense now.

name: James K.
text: Honestly felt like I was losing my mind those first few weeks. Wish I had this guide when my daughter was born, but sharing it with my brother now.

name: Patricia L.
text: Does this work for all babies though? My son's cry always sounded different from what people described, and he turned out to have reflux. Just saying experience matters too.

name: Marcus D.
text: The hungry cry vs. tired cry section was a game-changer for us. Our little guy is 3 months old and we've finally stopped second-guessing everything.

name: Emma T.
text: Real talk: no guide worked for my twins because they seemed to have their own unique cry signals. But I appreciate the scientific approach here even if YMMV.
